title: Unicode 1.0 released
summary: The Unicode Consortium, incorporated in California in January 1991, published Unicode 1.0 that October with 7,129 characters in 24 scripts, the first step toward one code for every writing system.
why: A single standard designed to let text in all the world's writing systems move between computers.

notes.problem: Unicode 1.0 did not code 'every character of the world's writing systems' (24 scripts, no Han until 1.0.1; source table).
